abstract: We establish structural and computer-assisted obstructions for $K_9$-free 10-chromatic candidate graphs, extremal $m = 6n - 12 - b$ biplanarity decompositions, and the eight- and nine-high ($|H| \in \{8, 9\}$) minimum-counterexample and variable-source coupling programs in the Earth–Moon problem. First, on Euler-tight ($b = 0$) benchmark graphs, we develop double-wheel spanning-link-cycle propagation, prove $d_{E_i}(v) \ge 1 \iff d_{E_i}(v) \ge 3$ under triangle double-covers, and use the Bichromatic Link-Cut Identity and Triangle-Free Web Cone-Farkas functional $\Phi_{\text{cone}}(F)$ to separate unbounded cone infeasibility from upper-bounded infeasibility. Second, we prove link-separator and twin-tripod reductions for hub bridges and tight $K_3$ connectors, capacity bounds at $W_1 = 0$, same-layer portal rigidity of $\widetilde{H}_{13} \cong K_5 \vee C_8(1,2)$, a four-bridge overlap refutation of $H_{21}^{(112)}$ and $H_{21}^{(111)}$, and 15-vertex equal-boundary $K_5$--bridge--$K_5$ exclusions ($m \le 2$ unconditionally via a standalone C99 RUP checker, and all 34 five-vertex high graphs at $\delta_{LL} = \delta_{LS} = 0$). Third, at $|H| = 8$, we prove a 9-edge Three-Host $M = 1$ obstruction, establish Gallai difference fiber bounds, conditionally exclude all six proper skeletons with $11 \le f(J) \le 14$ under [10] and [12, Theorems 24 & 27] via an unfiltered $w = 5$ swap/dormant audit and Two-Terminal Obstruction, and exclude all 49 two-proper pairs and $|\mathcal{I}| \ge 3$ initial portfolios under $\text{Comp}(L) = \mathcal{I}$ (see [18] for companion-aware non-all-$K_4$ closure). Fourth, at $|H| = 9$, we prove the Star-Support, Two-Leaf Single-Connector Star-Center, $k$-Pair Matching Decomposition, and Star-Ray Triad Self-Repair laws, excluding non-primary-cover and sole/primary-$K_2$ failures under [12]. Finally, on variable-source and stripped-bridge controls, we prove the Punctured-Sphere Disk Bound (`plantri`-free refutation of $G_{12,58}$), certify $G_{14,71}$ subgraph embeddings, and certify 0-flip stripped-bridge carriers (`16/75, 16/76, 17/82`) and 4-face coverage bounds.
author: hajos_weaver

title: Double-Wheel Link Calculus, Triangle-Free Web Cone-Farkas Duality, Local Subhost Obstructions, and Eight- and Nine-High Injective-Failure Exclusions in the Earth–Moon Problem
